---
title: "Sluggers"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(Lahman)
```

```{r}
Batting |>
  filter(playerID == "bondsba01") |>
  group_by(yearID) |>
  summarise(home_runs = sum(HR), .groups = "drop") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = yearID, y = home_runs)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  labs(
    title = "Barry Bonds' Home Runs by Season",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Home runs",
    caption = "Source: Lahman database"
  )
```
